open_questions: NV, quantum-dot readout and patch-reader power are unspecified in their sources.
The OPM needs a field of a few nT while the NV builds carry ~1 mT: how far apart, or how shielded, must they sit in one unit?
The renin readout needs a TIRF microscope; no wearable quantum-dot renin reader exists in the source.
